record.Description: The recalled electric balloon pump is a high-pressure pump that has two operation modes, continuous and touch-on. It is made of plastic and comes in pink with a blue handle and features two nozzles. The pump's model number, 406198, is printed on the silver rating label located on the bottom of the product and on the packaging.
record.Title: Dollar Tree Stores Recalls Electric Balloon Pumps Due to Burn Hazard
record.ConsumerContact: Dollar Tree Stores, Inc at 877-530-8733 between 7 a.m. and 11 p.m. ET Monday through Sunday, email at ddirect@dollartree.com or on-line at https://www.dollartree.com/product-recalls or https://www.dollartree.com and click on "Recall Information" at the bottom of the page.

Images.Caption: Silver rating label on bottom of the product showing model number (406198)

Injuries.Name: The firm received three reports of overheating, including one report of flames inside the unit and one report of the unit exploding.  No injuries have been reported.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Dollar Tree stores nationwide and online at dollartree.com, and doordash.com between August 2025 and July 2026 for about $17.

Distributors.Name: Dollar Tree Stores, Inc. ("Dollar Tree") of Chesapeake, Virginia

Hazards.Name: The recalled electric balloon pumps can overheat, posing a burn hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled electric balloon pumps immediately and return it to any Dollar Tree store to receive a full refund. Consumers who purchased the electric balloon pump online should contact the firm to receive a pre-paid shipping label to return the recalled product to receive a full refund.

ai.summary: Dollar Tree has recalled about 360,500 electric balloon pumps, model number 406198, featuring a pink plastic body, blue handle, and two nozzles. These high-pressure devices can overheat, which creates a burn hazard for users. Dollar Tree has received reports of the pumps overheating, including incidents where a unit caught fire inside or exploded.
ai.next_steps: Consumers should stop using the recalled balloon pumps immediately. You can return the product to any Dollar Tree retail location for a full refund, or reach out to the company to get a prepaid shipping label if you ordered it online.
